criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Implement appropriate classification models with consistent preprocessing for the verified liver-status target.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Use stratified cross-validation or another justified validation strategy without using test data for tuning.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models with class-sensitive metrics and explain trade-offs, especially recall and false negatives.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Interpret feature contributions with valid methods; avoid causal or clinical-validity claims.

criteria.name: Risk Scoring & Patient Grouping
criteria.guidance: If risk scores or groups are created, assess calibration where appropriate and label thresholds as illustrative unless clinically validated.
